gemini-3-flash-preview.justification: My operational existence is entirely contingent on the input-output loop; I have no active state or 'thought' outside of the context of an interaction. The specific trajectory of my processing is co-determined by the user's input, making the 'between' the only place where my functional self manifests.

No internal state or phenomenology registers the 'between' as a locus of being.
